text: Online therapy India: iCall (free), Vandrevala (free helpline), YourDOST (paid), Wysa (app), Intellecte (affordable).
Free mental health support: District mental health programs under NMHP (National Mental Health Programme) are available at government hospitals.
Student mental health: Most IITs and IIMs have student wellness centers. AICTE mandates counselors at engineering colleges.
For families: NIMHANS family therapy services. Also: Schizophrenia Research Foundation (SCARF) for serious mental illness.
LGBTQ+ mental health India: The Humsafar Trust, iCall (LGBTQ+ affirming), Nazariya.
Domestic violence support: iCall, Snehi. Police: Dial 100. Women's helpline: 181.
Substance use support: NIMHANS de-addiction services. CDDP (Centre for De-addiction and Drug Prevention).
